blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 5 sold over 4 months against an average of 26.2 listed, about 21.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 3 sold. Condos and townhomes: 4 sold over 4 months against an average of 5.0 listed, about 5.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 2 sold.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Bridgeview?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 30 houses listed with 0 sold in the month and 4 condos and townhomes listed with 1 sold in the month in Bridgeview. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Bridgeview a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 25% on too few listings to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
